interpretation: 2/4 games have BOTH speedfarm and push variants. Pooled: 39% of all variants (32/83) are speedfarm-or-push. Synthesis verdict's 'universal binary axis' claim VALIDATES at presence-in-all-games level but the magnitudes are modest (push 22; speedfarm 9) and the 'binary' framing collapses if 'allround' is recognized as the dominant axis.
